machine_name: EM Interference Awareness Device — Type 1 (Fixed Station)
assembly_instructions: Cast the 14.5 m by 10.5 m reinforced concrete apron and embed anchor groups for the dish foundation, shelter skid, generator skid, mast base, phased-array feet, cable trench, fence posts, guy anchors, and ground bar.

Pour the cylindrical dish foundation, bolt down the azimuth turntable through its visible bolt circle, install the pedestal column, and attach the yoke crosshead, yoke arms, and elevation trunnions with the axis level and centered on the reflector hub.

Lift the shallow segmented reflector onto the trunnions, attach the backing shell, rim ring, hub plate, concentric depth rings, eight petal-panel overlays, eight radial rib seams, four feed-support struts, subreflector, and feed horn at the focal region.
Route the dish RF coax loop down the pedestal into the cable trench, attach its cable tag, then route the trench bundle to the shelter cable-entry gland and RF receiver rack.

Assemble the cutaway operations shelter by anchoring the floor skid through its four visible hold-down plates, then install the rear wall, right wall, roof cap, corner posts, front-edge frame members, personnel door, cable tray, racks, rack face modules, console, displays, keyboard, and operator chair.

Install the phased-array antenna on four bolted concrete feet, set the lower rail, tilted panel, side rails, top rail, rear braces, receive tiles, and visible array RF cable bundle leading to the shelter cable-entry gland.

Bolt down the mast base plate and four guy anchors, raise the fiberglass mast, tension the four guy wires through visible turnbuckles, and mount the discone, log-periodic boom, log-periodic elements, and GNSS timing puck.

Assemble the cutaway generator shed floor, bolt its skid to the apron, install rear wall, side wall, roof cap, generator set, battery block, fuel tank, fuel line, muffler, exhaust stack, UPS, and power-conditioning cabinet, then connect the power conduit to the shelter.

Install separate visible RF, timing, network, and conditioned-power cable runs inside the shelter so the receiver, timing, processing, recorder, console, and power chain can be inspected independently.
Bond the dish pedestal, mast base, shelter skid, generator skid, and perimeter fence to the copper ground bar with visible straps before energising the electronics.
Erect individual fence posts and upper/lower rails around the apron after equipment placement, keeping the south-west access opening clear for maintenance vehicles.

Verify the graph from the pad outward: sensors feed RF and timing racks, processing feeds displays and recorder, generator/UPS/power-conditioning feeds the shelter electronics, and all major metal structures bond to the grounding system.

info.japanese_name: 電磁妨害状況把握装置1型
info.english_name: Electromagnetic Interference Situation Awareness Device, Type 1
info.summary: Stationary ground station built by Mitsubishi Heavy Industries to monitor electromagnetic interference against Japanese satellites and to train JASDF units in countering communications-satellite jamming.
info.description: Type 1 is the fixed installation in the 電磁妨害状況把握装置 family — Japan's procurement of equipment to build situational awareness of electromagnetic interference targeting its artificial satellites. The system's mission is twofold: continuously observe the RF environment around Japanese spacecraft so that jamming or interference can be detected and characterised, and provide a training and evaluation capability for the Air Self-Defense Force against communications-satellite jamming. The prime contract went to Mitsubishi Heavy Industries in FY2021 (¥5.357B), and a follow-on function-enhancement contract was signed with MHI in FY2024. A companion mobile variant (Type 2) was contracted with NEC the following fiscal year.

facts.label: Modelled primary reflector
facts.value: 4.8 m diameter steerable segmented reflector with 8 radial ribs, 8 petal panels, rim ring, and 2 concentric depth rings

facts.label: Modelled operations shelter
facts.value: 4.6 m × 2.6 m × 2.7 m cutaway EMI-shielded equipment shelter

facts.label: Modelled antenna mast
facts.value: 6.2 m fiberglass mast with four guy wires, discone, log-periodic, and GNSS antennas

facts.label: Visible signal chain
facts.value: Dish RF, array RF, GNSS timing, and network/data runs are separate visible harnesses inside the cutaway shelter

facts.label: Power chain
facts.value: Diesel generator, battery, UPS, and power conditioner feed the shelter racks through a visible conduit

facts.label: Grounding model
facts.value: Dish pedestal, mast base, shelter skid, generator skid, and fence bond to a common copper ground bar
